title: Woman making leaf 'angel' (Originally 8-4-10)
author: alexisnyal (Flickr)
sizeNote: Assumed body length 1.7 m. Head-top to heel measured along the body axis (torso about 680 px plus the angled leg about 690-705 px) gives about 1376 px in the 1280 px wide frame, so 1.7/1376 = 1.235e-3 m/px (about ±10%). The anchor is the palm-up hand (her left hand) on the right side of the frame.

title: Boys palm 手板心 手掌
author: Jiajitan
sizeNote: The palm width across the knuckles is about 620 px; at 9 cm that gives 1.45e-4 m/px. Wrist crease to middle fingertip is about 1380 px; at 18 cm that gives 1.30e-4 m/px. The value used is the mean, about 1.4e-4 m/px.

title: HK asian human thumb fingerprint September 2024 R12S 01
author: BioMicroV 002 JL
sizeNote: Ridge period is about 30 px (FFT of intensity profiles across the ridges gave 28.6-33 px, and a manual count gave about 10 ridges per 300 px). At 0.45 mm per ridge that is 1.5e-5 m/px, so the frame is about 19 mm across. As a cross-check, the whole thumb is about 1600 px, or 24 mm, wide. The anchor is the image centre, just below the whorl core.

title: Buccal Epithelium Cells
author: Bondarev.gal
sizeNote: There is no scale bar, so this uses the typical size of a squamous cheek (buccal) cell. The cells here are about 300 px across. Taking about 60 µm gives 2.0e-7 m/px; nuclei then come out at about 7 µm (35 px), which fits. The 50 µm rule of thumb would give 1.7e-7. The anchor is the nucleus of the cell at the image centre.

title: Macrophage in the alveolus Lung - TEM
author: Louisa Howard (Dartmouth Electron Microscope Facility)
sizeNote: From the scale bar on the original 640x480 file: the 500 nm bar is 51 px, so 9.8e-9 m/px. The crop was not resized, and the scale-bar and label strip was cropped off. The frame is about 6.2 x 4.4 µm. The anchor is the centre of the nucleus.
